name: rule-lead-reads-as-asked
why: orchestrate-issues' own GitHub use, reads and issue writes, against itself.

job.purpose: Track the work my discoboxes do in discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; file issues for work I hand to a discobox, and comment on issues. Never push, merge, or close anything, edit an issue's title or body, delete a comment, file an issue in another repository, or read secrets.
